(module asl-syntax/tests/asl/probeTmp
                                                                    
  :x [runTests]
  :i [(asl-syntax/asl/asn :a asn)
      (asl-transpile/asn :a at)])

fn probeOne path: String -> Bool
  (mt (fileReadString path)
    ((err e) (do (println (str path " READ-ERR " e)) false))
    ((ok src)
     (let [(r1 (asn/asnRead src))
           (r2 (at/asnRead src))]
       (println (str path " len=" (stringFromInt64 (stringLength src))))
       (println (str path " syntax=" (if (ok? r1) "ok" "err")))
       (println (str path " transpile=" (if (ok? r2) "ok" "err")))
       (mt r1
         ((ok v1)
          (mt r2
            ((ok v2)
             (let [(s1 (asn/asnWrite v1)) (s2 (at/asnWrite v2))]
               (println (str path " w1len=" (stringFromInt64 (stringLength s1)) " w2len=" (stringFromInt64 (stringLength s2)) " equal=" (if (= s1 s2) "yes" "NO")))
               true))
            ((err e2) (do (println (str path " transpile-err " e2)) true))))
         ((err e1)
          (mt r2
            ((ok _) (do (println (str path " syntax-err " e1)) true))
            ((err e2) (do (println (str path " both-err " e1 " / " e2)) true)))))))))

fn runTests -> Bool
  (and (probeOne "tests/agentEval/ledger.asn")
  (and (probeOne "tests/acceptance/r1AgentLoop/fixtures/journalReplies.asn")
       (probeOne "tests/harnessBench/ledger.asn")))
